title: Probe into Social Media Posts that Targeted Singapore's Indian Community and Review of National Framework to Counter Such External Influences
what_it_is: Probe into Social Media Posts that Targeted Singapore's Indian Community and Review of National Framework to Counter Such External Influences

sections.label: Foreign content and investigations
sections.summary: The Member may withdraw the question; there is no evidence of a coordinated campaign, and investigations found content likely originated from a China-based platform.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If the Member is satisfied with the response, she may wish to withdraw the question after this session.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: There is currently no evidence to suggest that this is a coordinated campaign by any particular government or organisation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Investigations revealed that the content likely originated from a China-based platform, and was subsequently carried on other platforms and websites, including those in our local information space.

sections.label: OCHA directions blocking posts
sections.summary: The Government issued Disabling Directions under the Online Criminal Harms Act to block Singapore users' access to 14 online social media posts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The Government has issued Disabling Directions under the Online Criminal Harms Act (OCHA) to block access by Singapore users to the 14 online social media posts.

sections.label: Deepfake and AI content campaign
sections.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs rolled out a 2025 campaign on deepfake videos, AI-generated content and other inauthentic posts used to influence overseas jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs also rolled out a campaign in 2025 on the use of deepfake videos, AI-generated content and other inauthentic online posts to influence overseas jurisdictions to alert Singaporeans to this threat.

sections.label: Increase in AI-generated posts
sections.summary: An increase in such posts has been noticed, especially given the use of AI enabling their creation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Specifically, like I said in my response earlier, we have noticed an increase in the number of such posts, especially given the use of AI enabling the creation of such posts.

sections.label: FICA and OCHA directions effectiveness
sections.summary: FICA online directions were first used in July 2024, other OCHA directions were used, and they have been generally effective as social media companies complied.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Our online directions under FICA were first issued or first used in July 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We have also used other various online directions under OCHA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: They have been generally effective as the social media companies have worked with us and complied with the directions issued by the Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Of course, we will from time to time continue to review the laws to ensure that they are fit for purpose, to continue to be proactive in this space.
